en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The purpose of the subject is to give students basic knowledge in the field of General demography and its use in economic decision-making, to clarify basic sources of information, flow and procedures of data evaluation in population situation and processes. The use of demographic methods and data to study the basic questions on different decision-making levels in economic and social domain at the regional, national and international levels. To understand demographic aspects of social and economic development.
